steps.text: QA-RIG's truth run (the night of 2026-11-07, GATE-05, 07, 13, 14, 15, 20): day 1 at 1920x1080. (1) The office at rest is recorded for 30 frames with a still taken in the middle: seqtools colour holds the frame captured with the still to the still (mean R, G, B within 3; the old recorder's second sRGB encode read the mat 127,137,105 against 55,64,36). (2) The PC opens and closes by Q with full motion, each recorded: seqtools cuts judges them for single-frame jumps. (3) One stamp on the passport in the reading view, recorded: the press and the stamp's sound cues land in events.tsv ('cue' rows), and seqtools sound measures press to sound. harness.txt's first line is written after the frame analysis and is red on any red analysis line not on the known-red list.
